content:
We need to find a template that when applied to the given molecule (target) reproduces the described forward reaction (carbonyl-ene). We need to return mapped_rxn associated with the template and template_id (integer). We have tools: search_template_catalog_by_criteria, get_template, apply_template, etc. We need to find a retrosynthetic template that breaks the carbonyl-ene (i.e., reverse reaction). The description: forward reaction: alkene + carbonyl -> new C-C bond, C=C becomes C-C, C=O becomes C-O, forming hydroxyl and five-membered ring. So retrosynthesis: break C-O bond to form C=O and C=C. So functional groups broken: carbonyl (C=O) formed? Wait forward: carbonyl-ene: carbonyl (C=O) present, alkene present, product: new C-C bond, C=O becomes C-O (hydroxyl), C=C becomes C-C. So in forward, functional groups broken: C=O (carbonyl) and C=C (alkene). Formed: C-O (hydroxyl) and C-C (new bond). Also five-membered ring formed.

Thus for retrosynthetic search, we need templates where functional_groups_broken include "carbonyl" (or "ketone") and "alkene", and functional_groups_formed include "hydroxyl" and "C-C bond"? The tool expects functional group names from predefined list. We need to get list. Use get_available_functional_groups.
